name: David Berkowitz (anonymous silhouette, 1977-78)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. Berkowitz is alive, so he is drawn ONLY as an anonymous rim-lit silhouette (silhouette: 'cool' or 'warm'): no face, no features, no likeness. A generic young man in a plain short-sleeved shirt and slacks; never glamorised, never shown with a weapon, a victim or any violent act.
rules: Silhouette only, in every shot. Shown only walking to his car, being arrested, or standing in court. Every shot he appears in carries 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'.
